gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri has a high-waisted lowercase and small round letters with generously unclosed curves, a plain sans with room to breathe. And Righteous cuts against it with bowls that fill the line, like thin steel rod bent into every letter.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Contemporary through and through, Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified even at modest size, its terminals stopping well away from the stem. Righteous adds stencil-flat, single-weight strokes.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplem: Stocky, tall-bodied lines come from Noto Sans Tamil Supplement, whose round forms read like open parentheses. But Righteous holds its strokes at one thickness with no heavy-to-light shift, so give the sans a size that lets that tall middle band breathe.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Righteous draws every horizontal and vertical like rod stock, with bowls that fill the line. Noto Sans Tangsa softens that with wide, inviting openings on round letters and short ascender stems, a plain sans that feels approachable.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-tc: Approachable is the feeling Noto Sans TC gives right away. Its curves open outward instead of curling in, with generous counters in tall a, e and s, while Righteous keeps its stroke widths fixed from stem to curve above it.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Righteous looks like cut-out strokes made with a fixed-width router bit, all commanding bowls. Noto Sans Telugu is the quieter partner, a plain sans with a high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai reads like inflated glass beads, a swollen lowercase with rounded letters left open. And Righteous does the loud work, its straight-edged, constant strokes making headings feel commanding while the sans stays friendly.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Righteous has zero stroke modulation and bowls that fill the line. Noto Sans Thai Looped is a clean sans-serif with tall lowercase bodies that look bold, and the heading earns its keep when it runs big and brief.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Clean, fun lines define this pair. Righteous looks like glass tubing bent into letters and commands attention, while Noto Sans Tifinagh keeps rounded sans-serif bowls open and inflated for quieter work.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Contemporary and clean, Righteous has no hairlines anywhere in its alphabet. Noto Sans Tirhuta has a dominant x-height and terminals cut back to leave a big gap, so a modest size is enough to make it fill the line.
